why: Runs whose recorded synthesis.md no longer matches what today's renderer produces from the same artifacts. `adhd replay` fails on any drift NOT listed here, and also fails when a listed run starts matching again, because a stale baseline is how a real regression gets waved through. Recordings are never re-rendered to make this file shorter: a recorded synthesis is what the reader was actually shown, and rewriting it would make the corpus claim a run displayed something that did not exist when it ran. That is the same argument as former_ids in config/frames.yaml.

The recording reads as though both frames survived, which is exactly the confusion the change fixed.
